findings.name: Barbero
findings.purpose: Product page on Colorlib for the 'Barbero' barbershop website template. It is a customer-facing template landing page, not an admin/booking app. The page showcases the template's features with screenshots and a live preview link.
findings.why_relevant: The template is a free, responsive Bootstrap design for barbershops/salons, directly matching Vitrina's client vertical. It is customer-facing, with typical sections for services, pricing, and booking. The page credits the designer (Colorlib) via footer link.
